title: Suno
short_description: AI-generated songs and audio content for nonprofits
long_description: Suno is an AI-powered tool that enables users to generate complete songs from text prompts. It allows nonprofits and social purpose organisations to create audio content, including music with vocals and lyrics, for communication, storytelling, and digital engagement.

title: SurveyCTO
short_description: Secure, offline-first data collection platform for M&E and research
long_description:
SurveyCTO is a mobile-first data collection platform designed for NGOs, researchers, and development organisations to collect high-quality field data, run complex surveys, and manage monitoring and evaluation workflows in low-connectivity environments.

It enables teams to design advanced surveys, enforce data quality at the point of entry, and securely collect and manage sensitive programme data across mobile and web channels.

title: Synergy Connect
short_description: CRM platform for managing donor, fundraising, and programme data for nonprofits
long_description: Synergy Connect is a nonprofit-focused CRM designed for organisations to manage donors, fundraising, and programme data within a single system. It is built for ease of use and typically requires less setup compared to enterprise CRM platforms.

title: Synergy Donor
short_description: Donor management and fundraising workflow platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Synergy Donor is a donor management platform by SynergyConnect designed to support donor management, fundraising workflows, fund allocation, reporting, and related operational processes through a unified system. It supports donor and fundraising workflows from prospect management to MOU tracking, disbursement scheduling, donor communication, and reporting.

title: Synergy LMS
short_description: Learning and skilling management platform for nonprofits and CSR programmes.
long_description: Synergy LMS is a learning and skilling management platform built for NGOs, CSR foundations, and government programmes to manage training delivery, track learner progress, and support end-to-end skilling journeys from enrolment to certification and placement.

title: SynergySurvey
short_description: Flexible M&E data collection for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: SynergySurvey is a mobile-first monitoring and evaluation (M&E) data collection platform developed by SynergyConnect Data Innovations Pvt. Ltd., designed for Indian NGOs and CSR teams to collect field data offline, track beneficiaries, and generate programme insights through integrated dashboards.

title: Synthesia
short_description: AI video generation platform for structured training and communication content
long_description:
Synthesia enables organisations to create videos from text-based scripts using AI avatars and voiceovers, without cameras, studios, or on-screen presenters.
It is used to produce repeatable, standardised video content for training, onboarding, and programme communication where consistency is required across teams or locations.

title: Tableau
short_description: Data visualisation and analytics for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Tableau is a data visualisation and analytics platform that enables organisations to explore data, create interactive dashboards, and generate insights for reporting and decision-making.

title: Taiga
short_description: Agile project management for NGOs running iterative, collaborative work
long_description: Taiga is an open-source project management platform built for teams using agile workflows such as Kanban and Scrum. It helps nonprofits plan tasks, manage backlogs, track progress, and collaborate in real time for campaigns, digital initiatives, and evolving programme work.

title: TallyPrime
short_description: All-in-one software for invoicing, accounting, inventory, payroll, and banking.
long_description: TallyPrime is a widely used accounting platform in India for managing financial records, GST compliance, inventory, and reporting within a single system. It is primarily desktop-based, with optional cloud access features, and is commonly used by organisations working closely with accountants and compliance requirements.

title: Telegram
short_description: Community communication and broadcast platform for large-scale outreach.
long_description: Telegram enables large-scale outreach through channels and groups for community communication and updates. It supports structured communication and automation through bots. However, adoption may be lower than WhatsApp, and monitoring is limited to basic engagement.

title: Trello
short_description: Simple project management for nonprofits
long_description: Trello is a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to help teams organise tasks, track progress, and collaborate in a simple and intuitive way.

title: Turn.io
short_description: WhatsApp communication and engagement platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Turn.io is a WhatsApp Business API-based platform that enables organisations to design, automate, and manage beneficiary communication workflows at scale.

title: Twilio Calling
short_description: AI-Led Customer Engagement & Communication Platform
long_description: Twilio is a cloud-based customer engagement platform that enables organisations to manage messaging, voice, email, authentication, and AI-powered communication workflows through programmable APIs and customer engagement tools.

title: UVDesk
short_description: Helpdesk and query management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: UVDesk is a helpdesk platform that enables organisations to manage beneficiary, donor, and stakeholder queries through a structured ticketing system. It supports ticket management, workflow automation, knowledge base creation, and multichannel communication helping teams organise and respond to queries efficiently.

title: Vyapar
short_description: GST billing, invoicing, and basic accounting software for small nonprofits and social purpose organisations in India.
long_description: Vyapar is a GST billing and accounting application used by small organisations to manage invoicing, inventory, expenses, and basic financial reporting. It is designed for Indian users, with built-in GST compliance and offline functionality for environments with limited connectivity.

title: WATI
short_description: WhatsApp communication and engagement platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: WATI is a WhatsApp Business API-based platform that enables organisations to manage conversations, automate workflows, and engage users through structured messaging.

title: WhatsApp
short_description: Messaging and communication channel for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: WhatsApp is a widely used messaging platform that enables organisations to communicate and engage with users through chat-based interactions. Through the WhatsApp Business app and API, organisations can manage conversations, send updates, and build structured communication workflows.

title: WhatsApp Business
short_description: Messaging platform for direct outreach, engagement, and supporter communication
long_description: WhatsApp Business enables direct, real-time outreach with communities and beneficiaries. However, monitoring is limited, and structured tracking requires additional tools or API integration.

title: Wix
short_description: Drag-and-drop website builder for nonprofits
long_description: Wix is a cloud-based website builder that allows organisations to create professional websites using drag-and-drop tools and pre-designed templates, without coding. It also includes tools for donations, events, email campaigns, and contact management in one platform.

title: Wordwall
short_description: Interactive learning and assessment tool for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Wordwall is an online platform that enables educators and organisations to create interactive learning activities such as quizzes, games, and assessments for classroom or remote learning. It supports engagement through gamified formats and reusable templates.

title: X
short_description: Real-time public communication and advocacy platform for nonprofits and SPOs
long_description:
X (formerly Twitter) is a platform used by organisations to share real-time updates, participate in public conversations, and engage with media, policymakers, and broader audiences.

It is commonly used by nonprofits to communicate time-sensitive information, contribute to public discourse, and build visibility in policy and advocacy ecosystems.

title: Xero
short_description: Cloud-based accounting and financial management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Xero is a cloud-based accounting platform used by organisations to manage invoicing, expenses, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting. It is widely used by organisations operating across multiple countries, offering multi-currency support and integration with a wide range of financial and business tools.

title: ZAMS
short_description: AI-powered workflow automation platform for outreach and donor communication coordination
long_description: ZAMS is a platform that uses AI agents (“AI workers”) to automate routine tasks that support nonprofit outreach and communication workflows, such as updating donor records, tracking engagement, retrieving information, and coordinating follow-ups across systems.

title: Zabbix
short_description: Open-source infrastructure monitoring tool for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Zabbix is an open-source monitoring software tool for a wide range of IT components, including networks, servers, virtual machines, and cloud services. It provides real-time monitoring of performance metrics, availability, and alerts for system issues.

title: Zapier
short_description: No-code automation platform for connecting apps and workflows for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zapier is a web automation platform that allows users to connect different web applications and automate workflows. It enables the creation of "Zaps" which are automated workflows between apps without requiring coding knowledge.

title: Zimyo
short_description: HR, payroll, and employee management platform for organisations in India
long_description: Zimyo is a cloud-based HR and payroll platform used by organisations to manage employee data, payroll processing, attendance, performance, and recruitment within a single system. It is designed for Indian organisations, with built-in support for statutory compliance and workforce management processes.

title: Zoho Analytics
short_description: Business intelligence platform for advanced data analysis and dashboards
long_description: Zoho Analytics is a business intelligence and data analytics platform that helps organisations combine data from multiple sources, create dashboards, and generate insights for reporting and decision-making. It supports advanced analysis, reporting, and data visualisation across programmes and operations.

title: Zoho Books
short_description: Online accounting and GST-compliant financial management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho Books is a cloud-based accounting platform used by organisations to manage invoicing, expenses, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting in a single system. It supports GST-compliant workflows in India, enabling organisations to generate invoices, track taxes, and maintain structured financial records.

title: Zoho CRM
short_description: Customisable CRM for managing donors, beneficiaries, and operations at scale
long_description: Zoho CRM is a flexible CRM platform that enables nonprofits to manage relationships, workflows, and data across fundraising, programme delivery, and operations within a single system.

title: Zoho Creator
short_description: Low-code platform to build custom web and mobile apps for nonprofits and social purpose organisations.
long_description: Zoho Creator is a low-code application development platform that allows users to build custom web and mobile applications. It includes features for data collection, workflow automation, business intelligence, and integrations, enabling the creation of tailored business solutions.

title: Zoho Forms
short_description: Online form builder for structured data collection and workflow automation
long_description: Zoho Forms is a no-code form builder used to create online forms, collect structured data, and manage workflows such as registrations, applications, and approvals. It is typically used in operational contexts where form submissions are part of a broader process rather than standalone data collection.

title: Zoho One
short_description: Integrated business and workforce management suite for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho One is a cloud-based suite of integrated business applications that enables organisations to manage HR, recruitment, finance, operations, and other functions within a single platform. It includes tools for employee management, hiring, and workforce coordination, while connecting data across multiple organisational processes.

title: Zoho Payroll
short_description: Payroll and statutory compliance software for nonprofits and organisations in India
long_description: Zoho Payroll is a cloud-based payroll system used to manage salary processing, statutory compliance, and employee payouts. It is designed for Indian organisations, with built-in support for tax calculations, payslips, and regulatory filings.

title: Zoho People
short_description: HR management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Zoho People is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage employee data, attendance, leave, performance, and HR processes within a single platform. It integrates with other Zoho applications to support payroll, recruitment, and broader workforce management needs.

title: Zoho Projects
short_description: Project management platform for planning, tracking, and team coordination
long_description:
Zoho Projects is a project management platform used by organisations to plan tasks, assign responsibilities, track progress, and manage timelines across teams.

It helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations organise project workflows, improve coordination, and monitor execution of programmes and initiatives.

title: greytHR
short_description: HR, payroll, and training management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: greytHR is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, compliance, and employee records within a single platform. It includes integrated learning capabilities through VioletLMS for tracking staff training alongside core HR operations.

title: inkscape
short_description: Free, open-source vector design tool for NGOs and SPOs.
long_description: Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor. It enables users to create and edit scalable vector graphics (SVG), including illustrations, diagrams, line art, charts, logos, and complex design compositions. Being vector-based, outputs scale without quality loss to any size.
